title: Pure Dracoslayer

summary: Pure Dracoslayer Pendulum build with generic Pendulum support and staples. Dracoslayer Pendulums destroy and summon each other out of the Pendulum Zones to load the face-up Extra Deck and climb into Ignister Prominence, Majester Paladin, and Dinoster Power.

summary.title: Starters & Scales
points: Luster Pendulum, the Dracoslayer (Scale 5 Level 4 Tuner) destroys the card in your other Pendulum Zone to add a copy of that card from the Deck to your hand, loading your face-up Extra Deck while replacing the Scale.

Majesty Pegasus, the Dracoslayer (Scale 2) searches a Dracoslayer Pendulum with a different name and destroys a card in a Pendulum Zone, or discards itself as a Quick Effect to make your Dracoslayers untargetable and indestructible by the opponent's effects this turn.

Wind Unicorn Parallel, the Dracoslayer (Scale 2, newest card) Special Summons itself or a lower-Level Pendulum from your Pendulum Zone, and when Pendulum Summoned it is untargetable and indestructible by the opponent's effects while bouncing one of their cards on either turn.

summary.title: Opening: Luster Pendulum + Ignis Phoenix / Majesty Pegasus
steps: Place Luster Pendulum, the Dracoslayer and Ignis Phoenix, the Dracoslayer in the Pendulum Zones; use Luster Pendulum to destroy Ignis Phoenix and add a second copy of Ignis Phoenix to your hand.

Destroyed Ignis Phoenix triggers to Special Summon Majesty Pegasus or Dinomight Powerload from the Deck (treated as a Tuner), and you link two monsters into Beyond the Pendulum to search another Dracoslayer Scale.

Pendulum Summon your face-up Extra Deck and hand Dracoslayers, then combine them into Ignister Prominence, the Blasting Dracoslayer, Majester Paladin, the Ascending Dracoslayer, and Dinoster Power, the Mighty Dracoslayer.

summary.title: Dracoslayer Extra Deck Trio
summary.text: The three classic Dracoslayer Extra Deck monsters loop into each other without using your Pendulum Summon: Ignister Prominence (Level 8 Synchro) destroys a Pendulum on the field or in the Pendulum Zone to shuffle an opponent's card into the Deck without targeting and Special Summons a Dracoslayer from the Deck; Dinoster Power (Level 8 Contact Fusion) protects your Pendulum Monster Cards and Pendulum Zones from battle and effect destruction while reviving a Dracoslayer from the hand or GY; and Majester Paladin (Rank 4 Xyz) searches any Pendulum Monster in the End Phase and detaches a material to summon a face-up Dracoslayer from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Disruption, Spells & Left out
points: Wind Unicorn Parallel, the Dracoslayer and Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres provide two non-destruction bounces on the opponent's turn, while Majespecter Draco - Ryu detaches materials when a Pendulum is Tributed to summon from the Deck.
Dinomight Powerload, the Dracoslayer (Scale 6) Special Summons the Dracoslayer in your other Pendulum Zone and recovers a face-up Dracoslayer from the Extra Deck when Tributed.
Wavering Eyes destroys both Pendulum Scales to trigger Ignis Phoenix and search a Pendulum Monster, while Pendulum Reborn summons a Pendulum from the Extra Deck or GY.

Left out: External Superheavy Samurai, Majespecter, and Odd-Eyes engines are omitted, Master Peace, Draco Face-Off, and Forge of the True Dracos stay out because they require Dracoverlord cards, and Baronne de Fleur is Forbidden in the TCG.
